links.outcome: Readability of chatbot prostate biopsy patient information, measured by Coleman-Liau Index
links.effect: Coleman-Liau Index values showed advanced reading levels across all four chatbots' responses.
links.quote: Coleman-Liau Index values showed advanced reading levels across all responses.

links.outcome: Concordance of chatbot prostate biopsy information with European Association of Urology guidelines
links.effect: Guideline concordance was moderate to good overall, with differences between platforms.
links.quote: Guideline concordance was moderate to good overall, but differences remained between platforms.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on generating patient education materials for prostate biopsy using expert clinician ratings and readability formulas; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
